summary: Diff implements new message color/effect enums (Blue/Purple/Dodge), adds a group composer style picker with plan gating and locked-option toasts, and sets group default color to Blue with reset-after-send behavior. However, evidence is insufficient that the group input textbox itself was styled blue (REQ-7) and that a reliable plan-tier determination/query is fully implemented end-to-end (REQ-11). Several unrelated UI/features were also modified beyond the requested scope.

missing_requirements.requirement: Make the group chat composer message input textbox visually blue by default in group chats, without changing DM textbox styling.
missing_requirements.reason: GroupConversation.tsx shows state defaults to Blue for message color, but the diff summary does not show any blue-specific styling applied to the actual <Input> textbox (e.g., className changes for background/border/focus ring). The file is truncated before the input rendering details.

missing_requirements.requirement: Define and implement how the app determines the user’s plan tier using existing premium membership data model where possible; if new backend state is required, add it to Motoko UserProfile and expose a query for the frontend to read the current tier; treat unauth/profileless users as Free.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend types add membershipTier to UserProfile, and frontend adds membershipTier utilities and a useGetCallerMembershipTier hook usage, but the diff summary does not show the backend query method implementation (e.g., getCallerMembershipTier) nor how membershipTier is computed/assigned from existing premium fields (isPremiumMember/premiumExpiresAt/freeTrial).

hallucinated_features.description: Direct-message (ChatWindow) message styling updates (color cycling extended to Blue/Purple and Dodge effect rendering).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focused on group composer styling and plan-gated style controls; it explicitly required DM textbox styling remain unchanged, and did not request DM message-style feature changes.

hallucinated_features.description: DailyItemsSecretPage UI/behavior changes (mystery box animations/emoji, layout).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in any REQ; unrelated to group chat composer styling or message style gating.

hallucinated_features.description: Search/user card and group chat creation/navigation wiring changes (e.g., Start group chat button behavior, SearchPage prop removal, NavigationProvider usage updates).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; outside the stated non-goal of avoiding broader UI redesign beyond group composer and style changer controls.
